notes.title: PATCH NOTE 1.3.0
notes.notes:
New Logo, new Home, new game mode, new shot, heavy !!!

I / Career Mode

Now a third mode of play is emerging, with the career mode launching you into network fights and accumulate points and special moves as you advance, attention defeats make you lose fists and you can also regress.

II / Aura

Now the Stamina is also represented around your character in the form of a blue aura, the less you have left and the intensity will decrease, this is to facilitate your reading during the fight and bring a more fun to your fighter.

III / Rage Mode

As soon as your life reaches 20% you can trigger it by pressing R2 + L2 + Backward direction, what happens will depend on your fighter style but what is sure is that your shots will do a lot worse, be careful it does not lasts only 10 seconds!

IV / COMPETITOR STYLE:

SENSEI: Can launch projectiles and benefits from the Simdhal effect
 
 PUNCHER: The special moves will send your opponent in cabbage if your stamina is 100%

3 LUNGS: All shots are faster than reality and all other categories of fighters.

THE BLOCK: Do not even play the animated miss since it's supposed to not hurt LOL, in Rage mode, it's getting bigger!

BADASS: In development


The Dev team

notes.title: PATCH NOTE 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Update 1.2.0: Authentic, Effects, Workshop and Ring

What's more beautiful as a Christmas present than a major update from Youfight?
On the agenda of our holiday gala, find a new game mode, a new effect, a new character sharing feature and new rings.


I / Authentic Mode:

You find that jumping, and throwing balls of fire is "too much" to overcome your opponents? So come face-to-face in the brand new game mode of Youfight: The Authentic Mode. He gives pride of place to the combat simulation. Here no superfluous, only sweat and technique will make the difference. An authentic match takes place in 3 rounds of 3 min. Match strokes and combos to score the most points and win.

II / Effects:

In order to expand the customization possibilities of fighters, two new effects are available in game.
 
 Dhalsim:
Choose whether or not to apply it when selecting an animation of a punch or kick, and you will have the opportunity to stretch your members at will.

Kiuglan:
Chain fists at a bewildering speed with this effect. With a new key combination, send a live salvo to your enemy. And the most incredible in the story is that no modification of your character is needed to enjoy it.

III / Workshop:

Youfight's 1.2.0 update also gives you the opportunity to share your character with other players via the Steam workshop. Find all the characters shared by the Youfight community in just a few clicks. You can also rate other players' creations and manage your fighter library from the Youfight SteamWorkshop page.

Adding and playing a fighter shared by another player is of a disconcerting simplicity:
* Go to the workshop page of the fighter you want to use and subscribe to it.
* Launch the game and fight with it.

IV / Rings:

For Christmas at Youfight we see things big, and it's not one, not two, but three new rings available.

TROCADERO PLACE: Let's be a little chauvinistic with this new ring that will allow you to fight on the forecourt of the Trocadero. Chase the fighting in front of the Eiffel Tower, the Champ de Mars, the Invalides and even Montparnasse.

ROBOT FACILITY: Come face you in the factory of THINK TECHNOLOGIES company, in the middle of the chain of production of their famous robots of 3rd generation. But be careful, in view of the propaganda visible in the factory, the real project of THINKS is perhaps not the one that we try to make us believe.

STRANGE GAS STATION: Thriller and bucheron atmosphere for this last ring. Come fight in front of this strange gas station lost in the middle of nowhere.


We still want to thank our backers and the people who support us. We also wish a wonderful end-of-year holiday to the entire Youfight community.


The Dev team

notes.title: PATCH NOTE 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Patch note 1.1.1

additions:
2 new Ambassadors are available
3 new arenas: Trocadero Place, Strange Gas Station and Robot Facility
Ability to choose his order of display from the bookseller of blow
Ability to choose the threshold manually via a new field
Ability to navigate between manual selection fields with the TAB and SHIFT + TAB keys
Ability to navigate between character information fields when creating the character with the TAB and SHIFT + TAB keys
Added 17 new collision effect variants for projectiles
Added a Reset button during character creation to cancel all choices made
Added a Back button while loading characters

modifications:
Changing the display order in the hit bookseller
Change of collision effects for projectiles
Decreased size of collision effects
The name of the hit selected in the character creation is now automatically pre-selected in the animation editor
When selecting a fighter it's now all his shots are played instead of just playing the posture.
Change the display management of arenas when choosing the latter

Bug fix:
The scroll is now done correctly in the hit library
Selection of a frame interval when creating an animation is now correct under MacOS
Correction of a rounding problem in the minimum time limiter of selection
The scaling up of fighters is no longer wrong when they have their arms in the air
When modifying a fighter, the collision effects previously chosen

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.0: Jump, Projectile & Customization
notes.notes:
[Img] http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30963884/692e8f8f8d079a13feba8ec0c67da914819a4d9a.png [/ img]

Here is the biggest update of YOUFIGHT since the beginning of the early access on Steam. Enter a new era of combat with the possibility of JUMPING without risking breaking your leg !. This update also gives pride of place to the customization of his character with no less than 83 new effects available.

[Img] http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30963884/812e84bbbd3d2b9fc29267cc5207ca7af186bbd3.png [/ img]

You could have a taste on the screens of the store page, the Projectiles are now available for everyone. Combo 4 of all the characters has undergone a redesign and will now allow everyone to send a projectile. Fireball, lightning or other plasma particle, choose your projectile among the 17 variants already available!

[Img] http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30963884/e9367bb21ce24ad209f62edf3e7d9c1892eeba6f.png [/ img]

[Img] http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30963884/a3f5514f05dd38c7b359d08332e9175320632e0e.png [/ img]
[Img] http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30963884/61a179e38b1c4a5e8be97fa2ef704781c4314d27.gif [/ img]

You have asked us from the beginning and it is now possible in YOUFIGHT: SAUTER. What could be more logical than to accompany the arrival of the projectiles in game with the jump to evade them? It is now possible for you to jump, all with an effect dedicated to the colors of your fighter.

[Img] http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30963884/e79ff1ef31361bf456b0d84ded1fde9dc97cb7db.png [/ img]

[Img] http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30963884/b90ac154e03cbca5dfbb032efc8e89cc5bd127e7.png [/ img]

[Img] http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30963884/a0680149ecb0ea654c922fd40b932659896dc464.gif [/ img]

[Img] http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30963884/ac4c4edb760262734e99ca83b176a8eb6df5573d.png [/ img]

What's more natural for a game in which each character is unique than pushing the customization of his character even further? Now when creating your fighter choose from over 66 collision effects in no less than 4 different categories. Each of your moves will be unique and will have a special effect.

[Img] http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30963884/2317675a303f9fd9b0d5b78d71c1866ed8a6ca88.png [/ img]

[Img] http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30963884/c5db6776adb4cf6b5b74e464266e576a0d2962e8.png [/ img]

[Img] http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30963884/901d6ceaa535c11b292fd6ad04871d98e4f5b581.gif [/ img]

In addition to these three major additions, the Jump, Projectile & Customization update also brings improvements and modifications, including:

[List]
[*] Video processing and uploads are now faster.
[*] Improved translation in game
[*] Changing hit statistics
[*] General improvement of the interface
[*] Full Note Patch
[/ List]


[b] [i] In view of the large number of changes made by the 1.1.0 update, it is recommended to remove any fighters that are being created.
[/ I] [/ b]

We would like to thank all our Ambassadors and Backers for Steam for their consistent and constructive feedback that allows us to continually improve our game.
Thank you for believing in us and long live YOUFIGHT!

[h1] The dev team [/ h1]



Find all these new features and more in the [b] YouFight update 1.1.0 [/ b] now available on Steam.


[b] [h1] Patch full note: [/ h1] [/ b]

[b] Add: [/ b]
[List]
[*] Check the available space on the disc before extracting the video.
[*] Tips during loading screens
[*] Projectiles on the combo 4
[*]Jump
[*] Customization of projectiles
[*] Customization of collision effects
[*] Time indicator during video cutting
[*] Flip button and rotate directly on the video
[*] New management of the size of the fighter at stake
[/ List]

[b] Change: [/ b]
[List]
[*] General improvement of the user interface
[*] Simplification of the hit creation interface
[*] Added ++ and - buttons to speed up video browsing
[*] General improvement of the translation
[*] Improved character search system
[*] Improved video processing process: Uploads have become instant and processing times improved.
[*] Modification of several gameplay parameters in a balancing optics
[*] Overhaul of the colli system

notes.title: PATCH NOTE 1.0.3
notes.notes:
* Added a rotation button on VideoEditor
* Added a search field in fighter selection

* UI change:
- Fixed some translation error.
- Character button now is at the right place.
- Home menu now always has a selected choice

* Bug fix:
- Fixed a bug where characters would not be saved in the cloud.
- Fixed a bug where Save & assign button would not assign move
- Fixed a bug where image would not be rescale at extract

Fixed several UI bugs :
- Preferences : Now the correct key is shown.
- Choose Map : DeadCity now has the right miniature.
- ChoosePlayer now has navigation arrows.
- Pause now has the right logo.
- General improvements of translation.
- Improvement of Combo animation.
- General improvements in UI.

Gameplay update:
- Increased Stamina use in general.
- Increased Guard damage reduction.
- Increased Stamina gain per sec.
- Fixed a bug where combos would hit twice.
- Decreased general speed at 1,5x.
- Combo now doesn't deal twice the damage in guard.
- Stats are no longer reversed.

Misc update:
- Added a message when a player isn’t logged into Steam.
- Added an urgent fix for the Steam creation character.
